blocks.title: Dialogue: On a Plane to Caracas

items: *A.* I’m *going back to* Caracas after spending a week in Mexico City.
*B.* How nice! Do you like Mexico?
*A.* Sure. It is a beautiful country.
*B.* Are you going back alone or together with this lady?
*A.* Oh! Excuse me. This is my wife.
*D.* Excuse me. Do you want a cup of coffee?
